content.text: Section 24 fully meets our preferred position, and no other clause undercuts it.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24.1 gives us an unrestricted right to assign to an Affiliate or to an M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only), matching the preferred position. Section 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically: Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness standard applies only in our favour) and may never assign to a direct competitor of ours. Section 24.3's mutual consent requirement is expressly limited to "other assignments," so it does not undercut the 24.1 carve-out. Section 24.4 confirms our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service, and Section 13.3 carries the licence rights across a permitted assignment. No change-of-control or assignment-triggered Vendor right appears elsewhere (Section 9 termination rights are breach/insolvency-based only). No redline needed.
